verdicts.title: Probabilistic estimation of the algebraic degree of Boolean functions
verdicts.abstract_excerpt:
The algebraic degree is an important parameter of Boolean functions used in cryptography. When a function in a large number of variables is not given explicitly in algebraic normal form, it might not be feasible to compute its degree. Instead, one can try to estimate the degree using probabilistic tests.
